name: Elden Ring
summary: FromSoftware's open-world action RPG set in the Lands Between, published by Bandai Namco in 2022 and expanded by the Shadow of the Erdtree DLC.
overview: Elden Ring is an open-world action role-playing game set in the Lands Between. You create a character, choose a starting class and explore a large map full of dungeons, bosses and optional areas, mostly without hand-holding.

The game rewards curiosity and patience. Combat is built around timing, stamina management and reading enemy attacks, and most difficulty comes from rushing or over-committing rather than from lack of stats.

Beginners do best when they learn the systems early: how to level up at Sites of Grace, how to use the Spirit Ashes and Torrent, and how to leave an area to explore elsewhere when a boss feels too hard.
notes: Our Elden Ring guides explain systems and decision-making rather than listing every item location, which changes less often and is documented well by community wikis.
